## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe
  their targets through `scripts/apply_quarantine.py`, while nightly
  KEEPS running the file to produce the un-quarantine repeat-run proof.

{"content":"# PR #1547 rework — merge-conflict resolution + review-thread fixes

## Issues/Notes

- **Merge conflict** (blocking): `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart` conflicted with `main`. Root cause: main's gh-1469 fix (`d5e8ba6c6`) deleted the `try { print('SUMMARIZE n=…') } catch (_) {}` debug dump that this branch had reformatted. **Resolution: take main's side (delete the block).** This is exactly the "better" option review threads `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rM5rb` / `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rM-DF` proposed — the orphaned `// ignore: avoid_print` (no longer adjacent to its `print`) is gone with the statement it guarded, so no dormant no-op comment survives.
- **Post-merge analyzer drift** (would have failed this PR's new `--fatal-infos` CI gate): the merge from main introduced exactly 2 new infos —
  - `lib/src/compaction/structured/ledger.dart:19` — `unnecessary_import`: a `show`-restricted import of `../compaction.dart` fully covered by the unrestricted import of the same library two lines below (the duplicate-import shape behind the telemetry thread's fleet-unblock diagnosis). Dropped the redundant import; `isSyntheticUserText` still resolves through the unrestricted import.
  - `test/cli/agent_cli_timer_test.dart:95` — `no_leading_underscores_for_local_identifiers`: local `final _fixedNow` renamed to `fixedNow` (4 occurrences, all inside `main()`'s closure scope).
- **Non-replyable open threads**: threads 5–9 in `pr_discussions_raw.json` carry `threadId: null` / `rootCommentId: null` (top-level machine records — two `dmtools:review-verdict` entries explicitly marked "Do not edit or reply", two APPROVE review summaries whose suggestion items are the same two findings fixed and replied to in threads 1–4, and a fleet-telemetry note stating "No action from the fleet side"). Only threads 1–4 have targetable IDs; each gets a reply in `outputs/review_replies.json`.
- CI: no failing checks at rework start. The two `--fatal-infos --fatal-warnings` `dart analyze` steps from this PR survived the merge (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:626,631`) and are green again on the resolved tree.
- Local-analyzer note: reproducing CI's analyze requires `dart pub get` at root **and** `dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart` (ci.yml:619) — without the latter, `office_addin/dart` files show `uri_does_not_exist` errors. CI already does both.

## Approach

1. Resolved the single conflict in `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart` by deleting the debug-print block (main's side — behavior-preserving, matches the reviewer's option 2), staged it, verified `git diff --check` and zero conflict markers repo-wide.
2. TDD for review threads 1/3 (`tui_editor.dart` undocumented fork divergence): **RED** — new hermetic source guard `test/cli/tui_editor_fork_sync_guard_test.dart` (pattern per `conflict_markers_reg_test.dart`) fails on the pre-fix header (`does not contain 'DEVIATES from the fork'`); **GREEN** — added the reviewer's suggested deviation note to the file header; the guard also pins the private `_undoStack` declaration so a future fork re-sync that restores the public field fails a test instead of surfacing as a `--fatal-infos` CI failure.
3. TDD for review threads 2/4: **RED** — with the print block temporarily restored, the existing gh-1469 glass guard (`test/compaction/structured_engine_test.dart` → `the fold summarize path never prints to stdout`) fails; **GREEN** — resolved tree (block deleted) passes. No new production code needed — deletion was the fix.
4. Post-merge infos fixed with the PR's own behavior-preserving patterns (drop fully-covered import; rename underscore local), then `dart format` self-heal on touched files per the pre-commit hook convention.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart` — merge conflict resolved (debug `print` + orphaned `// ignore: avoid_print` deleted, per main's gh-1469 fix).
- `lib/src/cli/tui_editor.dart` — header deviation note added (`DEVIATES from the fork: undoStack is _undoStack … keep this rename when re-syncing`).
- `lib/src/compaction/structured/ledger.dart` — dropped duplicate `import '../compaction.dart' show isSyntheticUserText;` (covered by the unrestricted import).
- `test/cli/agent_cli_timer_test.dart` — `_fixedNow` → `fixedNow` (lint rename only; plus `dart format` wrap collapse).
- `test/cli/tui_editor_fork_sync_guard_test.dart` — **new** hermetic guard test for the documented fork deviation.

blocks.text:
## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

- `dart analyze` + dart format clean (explicit dirs — `yoclip/` is a
  standalone video workspace with its own toolchain); example app also
  `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`.
- `dart test` green (integration-tagged excluded from test-core — issue
  #551: `test/integration/**` changes also run the `integration-mock` leg
  per-PR: no-key legs via `MockLlmServer`, `--exclude-tags llm,browser-ext,
  perf,pty`; child-agent-spawn PTY tests carry `pty` and stay in nightly
  (issue #553). Tag-only CI = llm smoke + publish + binaries; nightly keeps
  the full real-provider suite (pty-integration). Since gh-1537 there are
  NO main CI runs — "tag-only" is literal: tags/dispatch/schedule only.
  **The Quality gate is deterministic-only (gh-1199): mock LLM everywhere,
  live models never.** Real-provider files carry
  `@Tags(['integration', 'llm'])` and run ONLY in the tag-only
  provider-smoke job and nightly with secrets — the per-PR integration
  shards exclude them at selection (`shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm`) AND
  at invocation (`--exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`), so a model's mood can
  never block a merge. The boundary is self-enforcing:
  `scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` (static-gate step + pinned audit)
  fails any integration-tagged file that looks live without the `llm` tag;
  `test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart` proves the shard
  selection stays live-free. Real-model verification belongs to the bench
  harnesses (terminal-bench / harbor / MLS-Bench) run under supervision,
  plus manual `dart test --tags "integration && llm"` for debugging — NO
  scheduled-or-gate live runs in the PR path. A proven flake (red in ≥2
  distinct-SHA gate runs within 24h) is quarantined via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json` (checked in, reviewed in the fix PR;
  `flake-watch.yml` files the issue and opens the PR) — the gate legs pipe

blocks.text: Wait — "Formatted 5 files (1 changed)" but `--set-exit-if-changed` returned exit 0? That's odd: `--output=none --set-exit-if-changed` should exit 1 if a file WOULD change. Exit 0 with "1 changed" reported... Actually looking closer: with `--output=none`, the formatter shouldn't modify anything. "Formatted 5 files (1 changed)" means 1 file would be changed, and `--set-exit-if-changed` should make exit code non-zero. But fmt-exit=0 — because the `echo "fmt-exit=$?"` captured the exit of `tail`, not dart format (pipeline!). The pipe makes $? the exit of the last command (tail). Classic mistake. ## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The single CI gate is the SM pre-merge validation run (gh-1537): the
machine SM (#687, `machine-sm.yml` → factory-sm) updates the branch onto
main, dispatches `ci.yml` on the updated head, and merges only when green
— the tree that lands is byte-identical to the validated tree, so the
retired post-merge main CI run was pure repetition (and #1522's
tag-sourced versions remove the release-bot commits that retriggered it —
fewer main pushes → less SM queue churn). `ci.yml` fires on `v*` tags
(release pipeline), the 2h auto-release coalesce schedule, `release:
published`, and workflow_dispatch ONLY — never on `push: [main]`. The
serialized-validation invariant is alarmed by `sm-merge-guard.yml`: every
main push must carry a tree covered by a successful dispatched
validation, else one deduplicated `sm-guard` issue files (no nightly
backstop, per the owner's directive).

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).
